summary.headline: Lunar Node Applications by Zodiac Sign
summary.text: Astrological delineations for the Moon’s application after separation from conjunction and opposition to the lunar nodes, organized by zodiac sign. The Head concerns honor, scholars, rulers, agriculture, soldiers, waters, and sailors; the Tail concerns decline, deception, darkness, creeping things, earthquakes, horses, silver, and quicksilver.
